items.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: I recorded “Forest of the Amazon” with Villa Lobos and that had some moments.

ctx.x: How about classical experiences? Are there any particular pieces — Stravinsky or anything like that — you’ve ever had really challenging work in the symphonic world?
Yeah. I recorded “Forest of the Amazon” with Villa Lobos and that had some moments. And there are a number of symphonic things. Yeah. There were moments, a lot of moments.
I got to watch the Nashville Symphony rehearse “The Rite of Spring” once, and I was watching the score and I just couldn’t understand how can you play this?
